unit.unitinstructions:
Kennesaw Sociology and Criminal Justice People

Each card shows a portrait, followed by the person’s role title and research interests. Research interests are blank when none were listed.

Type or say the person’s first and last name, without a middle initial. Include compound names in full.

Practice uses adaptive scheduling and immediate feedback: 10-second study and drill periods, 5-second reviews, and a brief correct-answer confirmation.

Portraits and department information: Kennesaw State University, collected September 6, 2026. This lesson includes the 51 faculty and staff members with available portraits.
